title: ISO/IEC 20000
lead: The international standard for IT service management — defines requirements for a Service Management System (SMS).

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: ISO/IEC 20000 specifies requirements for organisations to establish, implement, maintain and continually improve a Service Management System (SMS). It is technology-agnostic and can be used alongside ITIL, SIAM or any other ITSM approach. Certification demonstrates that an organisation's service management processes meet internationally recognised standards.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: ISO/IEC 20000 certification is often a customer or regulatory requirement in ITOM engagements, particularly for outsourcing and managed services contexts. The standard provides a compliance baseline that validates the maturity of the service management operating model.

items.desc: The integrated set of policies, processes and resources for managing IT services.
Mandatory requirements that must be met for certification.
Third-party audit to verify conformance with the standard.
Ongoing measurement and improvement of the SMS.
The defined boundary of services and organisations covered by the SMS.
